name: How to Make Oleo-Saccharum

ingredients.name: lemons, peel only, trimmed of excess white pith

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl or mortar and pestle, muddle lemon rinds with sugar until lemon oils begin to be expelled.

Let stand, stirring occasionally, until a fragrant syrup forms, at least 1 hour and up to 1 day. Transfer oleo-saccharum to a container (either first straining peels out or leaving them in) and refrigerate until ready to use.

description: Leave lemon peels to sit with sugar and watch as this beautiful, bright and sunny syrup forms. It's great on everything from drinks to fruit salads and pancakes.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 5 min to 1 day 5 min.

Make-ahead and storage: Oleo-saccharaum can be refrigerated in an airtight container up to 3 weeks.
author: Michael Dietsch
